hero.eyebrow: Private document intelligence — 100% on your hardware

Your documents never leave the building: sending private business data to online AI is not an option for Vietnamese businesses.

product.title: A brain for your document archive
product.lead: A fully local private document intelligence system that turns thousands of loose files into a knowledge base you can question.

f1.title: Your data stays put
f1.text: Runs 100% on your own hardware. No cloud, no external APIs — nobody reads your files. Not even us.

f2.title: Every format
f2.text: PDF (scanned or text), DOC/DOCX, RTF, TXT, PPT/PPTX, Excel, ZIP/RAR archives and images (JPG, PNG, TIFF…) — 10,000+ documents. New and changed files are picked up and indexed automatically.

f3.title: Truly understands Vietnamese
f3.text: OCR tuned for Vietnamese text: diacritics, company stamps and handwritten signatures are detected and recorded (“signed” status). Complex tables are reconstructed cell by cell and re-read with OCR — even tables that break commercial engines.

f4.title: Cited answers
f4.text: Every answer points to the exact file and location — auditable and verifiable; nobody has to take your word for it. And if the answer isn't in your documents, KINESIS says exactly that — it never invents one.

f5.title: Self-classifying archive
f5.text: Each document is classified (contract, invoice, report…) with value, dates, parties and signature status — filter, don't just search. Duplicate files are detected automatically: if you delete the original, the next run restores it from its copy; data for deleted files can be purged from the database on request.

f6.title: Ask in your language
f6.text: Query in Vietnamese, English or Russian — retrieval stays native to the document's language, no translation step.

how.title: Four steps, one answer
how.lead: From a chaotic folder of files to a precise, cited answer — all running locally.

s1.title: Ingest
s1.text: Scans your folders and reads every format; OCR handles blurry, skewed scans, corrupted files and complex tables.

s2.title: Organize
s2.text: Each file is classified and stripped of metadata — value, dates, parties — summarized bilingually (VN/EN) and stored with structure.

s3.title: Ask
s3.text: KINESIS understands what you're actually asking about — which documents, which period, which conditions — and searches all of them at once.

s4.title: Answer
s4.text: One precise answer with file citations — in seconds.

f1.v: One workstation in your office — RTX 3090 with 64GB RAM is the minimum we recommend. Bigger archives or a faster first read = more GPUs.

f2.v: About 1,000 documents (scans included) are fully read overnight on standard hardware. Larger archives take proportionally longer — you get the estimate before we start.

f3.v: Setup, loading and tuning — counted from the day your files are handed over.

module.title: Second Brain — your second memory
module.text: A personal knowledge layer on top of RAG: links your notes, decisions and follow-ups to the exact source documents. In development — early clients get priority.

ft.title: Custom model fine-tuning
ft.text: If the standard setup isn't enough, we fine-tune models for your specific workflows — proprietary formats, industry terminology. Quoted per project.

q1.a: From one workstation in your office: an RTX 3090 with 64GB RAM is the minimum we recommend. More volume or a faster first read needs more GPUs/VRAM — we size it to your archive in the quote.

q2.a: One to two days including setup. Roughly 1,000 documents (scans included) are fully read overnight on standard hardware; larger archives take proportionally longer.

q3.t: What if the answer isn't in my documents?
q3.a: KINESIS tells you the archive has no such information — it never invents an answer. No source, no claim.

q4.t: Who can use it, and how is access controlled?
q4.a: Everyone you connect to the system. Access is per person — extra seats are priced separately in the quote.

q5.t: Which languages do the documents have to be in?
q5.a: Vietnamese, English and Russian out of the box — the OCR is tuned for Vietnamese diacritics, stamps and signatures. Other languages on request.
